Territory Bomb

Costs 10,000 Xergs. Removes up to 10 million acres (2,000 random plots) from another player's territory. An active Radar Station has a 50% chance to block it.

Kim Guo Un Nuke

Costs 22,500 Xergs. Removes up to 100,000 Gold from the target on a successful hit, plus up to 50 million acres (10,000 random plots) from another player's territory. An active Radar Station has a 50% chance to block it.

Gold Mine
